start: An Android phone without the MettleUp app, a WhatsApp invite link /j/CODE

steps.action: Tap the link
must_not: Another gym's name
A broken logo picture

steps.action: Tap Join in the MettleUp app
user_sees: Chrome comes back with the card 'First, get the MettleUp app' and the big button 'Get it on Google Play'
must_not: A loop between the page and the store
A dead button

steps.action: Install from Google Play, come back, tap Join in the MettleUp app
user_sees: The app opens on joining this gym
must_not: The code lost on the way

start: A computer browser, the invite link

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: 'Scan this QR code with your phone’s camera.'
must_not: A Join button that does nothing on a computer

start: An iPhone, the invite link

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: The App Store, when the iPhone app is set; otherwise 'The iPhone app is coming soon' and 'Until then, the front desk at <gym> can add you as a member.'
must_not: An Android-only Join button

start: The invite page of a gym that takes sign-ups online and has plans

steps.action: Read the card Not a member yet?
user_sees: 'Pick a plan and send your details to the gym from this phone. You pay at the gym desk.'
must_not: Words about paying that differ from the Become a member page
The card shown for a gym that is closed to sign-ups

steps.action: Tap Become a member
user_sees: The gym's Become a member page at /m/CODE
must_not: A page for a different gym

start: A wrong or old invite link

steps.action: Open /j/ with a code that matches no gym
user_sees: 'Ask your gym for a new link or their gym code.'
must_not: An endless spinner
Another gym's page

steps.action: Open the right link with no internet
user_sees: 'Check your internet and open the link again.'
must_not: 'Gym not found' for a gym that exists

start: The gym switches off online sign-ups after the link was sent

steps.action: Open the invite link again
user_sees: No Not a member yet? card
must_not: A Become a member button that leads to a closed page

start: The invite link forwarded to a stranger

steps.action: The stranger opens the link and the WhatsApp preview
user_sees: Only the gym's name, code and logo; title 'Join <gym> on MettleUp'
must_not: Any member's name or number
The inviter's phone number

start: An Android phone with the MettleUp app, the invite link from the gym

steps.action: Tap the link
must_not: Another gym

steps.action: Tap Join in the MettleUp app
user_sees: The MettleUp app opens on joining this gym
must_not: The Play Store when the app is already installed

start: An Android phone with only the older ForgeAI app

steps.action: Tap Join in the MettleUp app
user_sees: Chrome comes back with try=old and opens the older app on the join
must_not: A loop
A dead end with no way to Google Play

start: A link with a short code

steps.action: Open /j/ABCDE (5 letters)
must_not: A server error page

start: The gym changed its name a minute ago

steps.action: Open the invite link
user_sees: The old name for up to 5 minutes, then the new name
must_not: The old name kept for longer than 5 minutes

start: The invite link preview in WhatsApp

steps.action: Look at the link preview
user_sees: '<gym> invites you to the MettleUp app. Tap to join. Gym code <code>.'
must_not: The member's own name or number in the preview

start: An Android phone with the MettleUp app, the invite link from the gym; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With saved data saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Join your gym by invite link".
user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Tap the link
must_not: Another gym

steps.action: Tap Join in the MettleUp app
user_sees: The MettleUp app opens on joining this gym
must_not: The Play Store when the app is already installed
